verses.1: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
verses.2: Jesus called a little child to Him and set him in their midst,
verses.3: and said, "Truly I tell you, unless you turn and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven."
verses.4: "Therefore whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven."
verses.5: "And whoever receives one such child in My name receives Me."
verses.6: "But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a great millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depth of the sea."
verses.7: "Woe to the world because of stumbling blocks! For it is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come."
verses.8: "If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire."
verses.9: "And if your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell."
verses.10: "See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father who is in heaven."
verses.11: "For the Son of Man came to save what was lost."
verses.12: "What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, does he not leave the ninety-nine on the mountains and go to search for the one that went astray?"
verses.13: "And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray."
verses.14: "In the same way, it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish."
verses.15: "If your brother sins against you, go and show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained your brother."
verses.16: "But if he does not listen, take one or two others with you, so that every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses."
verses.17: "If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, let him be to you as a Gentile and a tax collector."
verses.18: "Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."
verses.19: "Again I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask, it will be done for them by My Father in heaven."
verses.20: "For where two or three are gathered in My name, there I am in their midst."
verses.21: Then Peter came to Him and said, "Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me and I forgive him? Up to seven times?"
verses.22: Jesus answered him, "I do not say to you seven times, but seventy-seven times."
verses.23: "Therefore the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants."
verses.24: "As he began to settle them, one was brought to him who owed ten thousand talents."
verses.25: "But since he had no way to repay, his master ordered that he be sold, along with his wife and children and all that he had, and payment be made."
verses.26: "So the servant fell down and pleaded with him, saying, 'Have patience with me, and I will pay you everything.'"
verses.27: "Then the master of that servant had compassion and released him, and forgave him the debt."
verses.28: "But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He seized him and began to choke him, saying, 'Pay what you owe.'"
verses.29: "So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, saying, 'Have patience with me, and I will pay you.'"
verses.30: "But he refused. Instead, he went and threw him into prison until he should pay the debt."
verses.31: "When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and reported to their master everything that had happened."
verses.32: "Then his master called him and said, 'You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you pleaded with me.'"
verses.33: 'Should you not also have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?'
verses.34: "And his master, being angry, handed him over to the torturers until he should pay all that was owed."
verses.35: "So also My heavenly Father will do to you, if each of you does not forgive his brother from his heart."
